name: launchpad
description: FastAPI + React fullstack starter for 1–2 day hackathons

scripts.db:reset: node scripts/py.mjs -m alembic downgrade base && node scripts/py.mjs -m alembic upgrade head && node scripts/py.mjs -m app.seed
scripts.lint: node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff check . && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.format: node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff format . && node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff check --fix .
scripts.start: npm run build && node scripts/py.mjs -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
